text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And so my dreams are dashed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But my resolve remains, awaiting the<n>day that I
realize my ideals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If strength is the mark of a ruler, then<n>I still have
one chance left to prove<n>mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. It is said that the Kikuka<n>Sho goes to the
strongest<n>Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us show the world that the<n>Emperor does not
yield.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we decide to aim for the<n>Kikuka Sho as
planned.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fine work today, President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The result may not have been what<n>you hoped,
but you raced with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I may have failed to meet your<n>expectations today,
but I swear that<n>next time, I will return victorious.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You mean...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I intend to aim for the Kikuka<n>Sho. My
march of conquest is not yet<n>done.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no doubt that you will acquit<n>yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But surely you realize that this will<n>strain your
schedule to the limit?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Summer may be coming, but you will<n>have more
press interviews than<n>ever. And naturally, the
student<n>council will be—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I'm listening. Please, continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With respect, you do look rather tired.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Forgive me. Even I can't<n>maintain perfect
form after a race like<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you should refrain from<n>student council
work for a little—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe we have already discussed<n>that point.
Let's move on to<n>something more constructive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To pick up on your earlier point, the<n>student council
has important work to<n>do come the summer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come now, Trainer. Surely you<n>haven't forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Every year, the academy holds a<n>summer camp to
help the students<n>improve their racing skills. The
student council helps to organize it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me. Air Groove, can<n>you contact
the bus company?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We need to change the number of<n>buses we'll be
hiring, and there are<n>also some other issues I
want to<n>discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That being said, the press is outside,<n>and I can
hardly keep them waiting.<n>Let's see now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back at the academy in two<n>hours. Could
you set up the meeting<n>for when I return?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even after the grueling ordeal that<n>was the
Japanese Derby, Symboli<n>Rudolf shows no signs
of relaxing her<n>unforgiving schedule.
